༄༅/ /rdo rje phag mo phag gdong can gyi sgrub thabs ye shes rab 'bar zhes bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rdo rje phag mo phag gdong can gyi sgrub thabs

ye shes rab 'bar zhes bya ba bzhugs/ na mo gu ru/ na mo badzra yo ṣa ི ta/ bam̐ yig bde chen rtag 'char ba'i/ /e yig stong chen klongs yangs la/ /gus pas btud de de'i sgrub thabs/ /brtse bas man ngag ji bzhin bshad/ / 'dir mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i rgyud las 'byung ba/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma phag gdong ma chen mo'i sgrub thabs sgom par bya'o/ /de'i tshul ni/ 'khor lo bde mchog dang drag po chen po'i sgrub thabs dang spyi ni 'dra'o/ /'on kyang khyad par ni/ rang gi snying khar ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥser po/ de'i 'od kyis bdag nyid phag mo phyag gnyis mar gyur nas/ rdo rje phag mo'i dkyil 'khor bla ma dang bcas pa/ zhes pa nas/ bde chen 'khor lo'i lte bar nyi ma zla dus me'i dal gyi stegs bu a ā nas/ zhu ba las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de gnyis kyi bar du hrīḥlas rdo rje hrīḥyis mtshan nas/ dbus su dpal rdo rje phag mo phag gdong mar gyur pa ni/ sku mdog ser la dmar ba'i mdangs/ /rlung zad sbom thung cher khros shing*/ /'jigs chen 'jigs mdzad 'jigs su rung*/ /mi bzad zhal ni sum cu lnga/ /gnyis lhag bdun cu gnyis kyi phyag /zhabs ni bco brgyad g.yon bskum zhing*/ /g.yas brkyang ba yi tshul gyis bzhugs/ /gcer bu ba spu'i 'phreng ba can/ /'dod chags chen po'i bde bas myos/ /bha ga nu ma mtho zhing rgyas/ /rtsa ba'i zhal gyi g.yas g.yon du/ /rab 'jigs zhal ni dgu dgu'o/ /de steng bdun dang slar yang drug /de steng du yang zhal gsum mo/ /rtsa ba'i zhal ni phag gdong 'jigs/ khyi dang lce spyang byi la stag /seng ge 'jigs 'di 'brug 'dra ba bzhin/ byed glang chen rta/ /bong gdong g.yas la rim pas so/ /g.yon du ba glang ma he dang*/ /spyang ki rus sbal chu srin dang*/ /ri bong bse dang g.yag muñdza/ /steng du sbrul dang sre mong dang*/ /rtsangs pa sram dang byi ba dom/

/dbus su mkha' lding gdong ste bdun/ / de steng bya rgod bya rog dang*/ /'ug pa bya dkar khra dang ni/ /srin bya'i gdong ste rnam pa drug /kun gyi steng ma'i dbus rma bya/ /g.yas g.yon ngur ba khyim bya'i gdong*/ /thams cad spyan gsum ldan pa la/ /rang rang kha dog 'jigs pa che/ / rtsa ba'i phyag gnyis rdo rje dang*/ /dril bu thugs khar bsnol nas 'dzin/ /mi snang rang gi thabs dang sbyor/ /g.yas pa'i lhag ma rim pa bzhin/ /ral gri mdung rings rtse gsum dang*/ /dgra sta gri gug mda' gsal shing*/ /tho ba 'khor lo cang te dang*/ /chu gri dbyug to mtshon rtse gcig /dung dang zangs dung dbyug gu gsum/ /rma bya'i mjug ma bya rog sgro/ /ro skra'i pir dang me thab ri/ /dbyug pa me long pi wang dang*/ /rkang lag glo ba rgyu ma dang*/ /sgra gcan sgrog dang gdos dang rkogs/ /nya rgya dang ni mgo med lus/ /'bar ba'i dmar nag 'jigs byed gzugs/ /g.yon pa'i lhag rnams rim pa bzhin/ /phub zlum mche ba btun shing zhags/ /thod pa gzhu dang kha ṭwāṃ ga /po ti phub chung yu ba can/ /sdigs mdzub g.yer kha'i 'phreng ba dang*/ /lcags sgrog brag dang dur khrod rdul/ /mdung thung rnga dang lpags rlon dang*/ /man bu bsreg shing ga da'i dbyug /phub ring mgo bo snying rus dang*/ /zor ba mig dang mkhal ma bzhag /spen pa phur bu ni dza pur/ /sog le khab dang rlud pu bshus/ /char sprin shing sdong lcags kyu bsnams/ /tha ma glang chen lpags rlon brgyangs/ /zhabs rnams rkyang bskum dor stobs kyis/ /g.yas pas khyab 'jug drag po dang*/ /tshangs pa nyi ma me dang ni// dbang po rlung dang bden bral dang*/ /gnod sbyin ji lta'i rim pas so/ /g.yon pas gshin rje 'dod lha dang*/ /zla ba chu lha nor rgyas dang*/ /sa dang tshogs kyi bdag po dang*/ /smin drug bu dang 'khor bsgyur rnams/ /gnon cing 'jigs par mdzad pa yin/ /zhal kun thod pa'i cod pan can/

/mgo bo'i 'phreng ba do shal byas/ /phyag rgya lnga yis rnam par brgyan/ /rkang gdub rdo rje'i 'phreng bas mdzes/ /dbu skra grol zhing me dpung 'bar/ /gar gyi nyams ldan sdang ba dang*/ / gdug pa thams cad 'joms mdzad ma'o/ /'dab ma rnams la/ shar du mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/ byang du lā ma ljang khu sogs spy-i dang mthun pa'am/ yang na mkha' 'gro ma g.yon nag g.yas ljang ba/ byang du lā ma g.yon ljang g.yas dmar ba/ nub tu dum skyes ma g.yon dmar g.yas ser ba/ lhor gzugs can ma g.yon ser g.yas nag pa/ mtshams bzhir thod pa bdud rtsi lngas yongs su gang ba'o/ / thugs kyi 'khor lo'i shar phyogs su li ra ma la yar khaṇḍa ka pa la dang rab tu gtum mo/ byang phyogs dzā landha rar mahā kang ka la dang gtum pa'i mig can ma zhes pa nas/ rdo rje sems pa dang brtson 'grus chen mo ste/ thams cad kyang sku mdog dkar po'o/ /dpa' bo thams cad phyag dang po gnyis kyi rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyi ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭwāṃ ga bsnams pa/ dpa' mo thams cad gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ gtso mo dang mtshungs shing g.yas brkyang gi bzhugs pa ste/ shes rab ma gtso bor gyur pa'o/ /shar sgor khwa gdong ma sngon mo nas/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba'i bar spyi dang mtshungs/ ma mo bcu gnyis po thams cad kyang*/ phyag dang po gnyis kyi gri gug dang thod pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyi ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ rnal 'byor ma sum bcu rtsa drug po thams cad kyang bcom ldan 'das ma dang mtshungs shing*/ ro'i gdan la gnas pa'o/ /rang gi snying khar oṃ ha dkar po nas/ bdud rtsis gang bas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag /chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso mo la rdo rje sems pa dang*/ 'khor rnams la gtso mo nyid kyi dbu brgyan/ dbang gi lha thams cad kyang bdag nyid la thim/ zhes pa nas/ dag pa dran pa rdzogs kyi bar du 'dra ba las

yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni rdo rje phag mo'o zhes 'don pa bsgyur/ skabs 'dir rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi yi ge dang bcas pa gsal btab/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa ci nus su bsgom la/ bzlas pa la mos na/ spro bsdu'i bzlas pa'-i dmigs pa gsal btab nas/ rdo rje phag mo'i rtsa ba'i sngags nyid gtso bor bzla zhing*/ 'di'i snying po ni/ phag gdong ma'i snying po nyid te/ oṃ ba daṃ dzu na nu ka rā/ lo syai gra se mu hūm̐/ kha hūm̐/ bhi pha/ kha ṭa/ ṇa ya ṭa hūm̐ swa hūm̐ hā/ pha oṃ ṭa phaṭa swāhā zhes zlas pas snying po ste las thams cad byed pa'o/ /mdun srin po dang mkha' 'gro ma bsgoms te oṃ phaṭa chgai bhakṣa ya phaṭa kṣa phaṭa zhes bzlas pas drag shul sgrub/ thun bsdu bar 'dod na/ gzhan rnams bde mchog drag po chen po'i mngon rtogs dang 'dra ba las/ snying kha'i hūm̐ zhes pa la/ snying kha'i hrīḥ zhes 'don pa spo/ gtor ma'-i cho ga mdor bsdus pa'i tshe sdom 'byung dang rgyas pa la spro na/ dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i rgyud nas 'byung ba ltar/ 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor chen bya'o/ /ma rung 'joms shing sgrub po la/ /mtha' dag bde ba'i mchog gter ba/ /sgrub pa'i las 'di goms pa las/ /lta stangs brgyad po 'grub ces thos/ /rdo rje phag mo phag gdong can gyi sgrub thabs ye shes rab 'bar zhes pa 'di yang*/ rgyud dang bla ma'i man ngag la brten te gang ba'i rdo rje'i zhabs rdul la reg pas rnal 'byor pa rol pa'i rdo rje'am/ sgrol ba'i mgon por 'bod pa rang lo gsum bcu pa la chos grwa gser mdog can du sbyar ba'o/ /dge'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/rdo rje phag mo phag gdong can gyi sgrub thabs ye shes rab 'bar zhes bya ba bzhugs/ - PAGE 404 -- PAGE 403 -- PAGE 400 -
